title: Josh Jung 2023 Topps Chrome #88BC-15 RC 1988 Topps Baseball 35th Anniversary
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 2023 Topps Chrome trading card featuring MLB player Josh Jung, part of the 1988 Topps Baseball 35th Anniversary set. This rookie card is a refractor variety, highlighting the Texas Rangers player in his debut season. Manufactured by Topps Chrome, this sports trading card is a collectible piece for fans of baseball and card collectors alike.
